# Contribution

Describe the gap this change fills and why the resource is worth recommending.

## Publication Evidence

Link the publisher or proceedings record and state the publication status. Explain any exception with primary evidence of the author's relevant foundational contributions.

## Review

- [ ] I read or used the resource and checked the annotation against the source.
- [ ] The title, authors, year, venue, and version of record are correct.
- [ ] I checked corrections and publication status.
- [ ] The contribution is relevant, non-duplicative, and placed in the appropriate section.
- [ ] Any non-peer-reviewed exception is clearly labelled and registered.
- [ ] I ran the applicable validation commands and explained any external failures.
